newsitem.title: USA: Bay View to acquire EXXE, Concord Growth.
newsitem.headline: Bay View to acquire EXXE, Concord Growth.

text.p: Bay View Capital Corp., a California bank holding company, said Thursday it has a definitive agreement to acquire EXXE Data Corp. and its unit Concord Growth Corp. in a deal worth up to $53.8 million.

Under the agreement, holders of EXXE's capital stock, warrants and options will receive $19.8 million and are entitled to payments of up to $34 million, depending on the future financial performance of Concord, which provides asset-backed financing to small businesses.
Bay View, based in San Mateo, Calif., is the holding company for Bay View Federal Bank, California Thrift & Loan and Bay View Securitization Corp.
The deal is expected to close in March, subject to the approval of EXXE shareholders.

Bay View also said its directors have approved a $25 million share repurchase. After this repurchase Bay View will have bought back about 1.3 million or 17.5 percent of the 7.4 million its shares outstanding.
Concord, based on the San Francisco Peninsula, has 13 loan production/sales offices nationwide.
Bay View's stock rose $3.75 to $55.75 on Nasdaq at mid-afternoon.
